description: CELAVI, Circular Economy Lifecycle Assessment and VIsualization, is a model published by the US National Laboratory of the Rockies for energy-material supply chains. It combines system dynamics, network material flows, discrete events and life-cycle impacts to compare circularity pathways. Users supply a material-network dataset, costs, technology assumptions and configuration files; outputs are spatial and time-varying material flows, costs and environmental indicators. Geographic coverage follows the supplied network and facilities. GPL-3.0 source, installation steps and a command-line run example are public. The README distinguishes the stable CELAVI branch from an experimental Circularity Futures branch, so results should be tied to the version used. A limitation is that learning curves, recovery rates and facility locations require case evidence; the package does not supply a universal circular-economy forecast. CELAVI can analyse recycling and new-material needs for renewable-energy infrastructure. The related catalogue PyPSA is an electricity model, not a materials-flow engine. No materials dataset or Python package was downloaded.
inputs: Materials network, costs and circularity scenarios
